description.en: Plugins for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏用的插件。

description.en: Lists installed plugins, shows where each one lives (right sidebar, settings, left menu, or no UI), pins favourites, opens a plugin folder in Finder, and browses the DSH plugin market with growth trends and search.
description.zh: 列出已安装的插件并标出入口（右侧栏、设置、左侧菜单或无界面），支持置顶、列表/卡片视图、在访达定位目录；市场页可以看目录增长趋势、7 天增长榜和全库搜索。

description.en: Adds a native "Phone access (iOS)" settings page: App Store QR, fixed Tailscale address/QR, and local access-password management. Pairs with the DSH Pocket iOS app on the phone.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页新增原生「手机访问（iOS）」：App Store 下载二维码、Tailscale 固定地址/二维码、本机访问密码管理，配合手机上的 DSH Pocket iOS 客户端。
